scripts.build: pnpm run build:ios && pnpm run build:android
scripts.eas:android:development: pnpm --workspace-root exec eas build --platform android --profile development
scripts.eas:android:preview: pnpm --workspace-root exec eas build --platform android --profile preview
scripts.eas:android:production: pnpm --workspace-root exec eas build --platform android --profile production
scripts.eas:ios:development: pnpm --workspace-root exec eas build --platform ios --profile development
scripts.eas:ios:preview: pnpm --workspace-root exec eas build --platform ios --profile preview
scripts.eas:ios:production: pnpm --workspace-root exec eas build --platform ios --profile production
